zh: （临时开场）方舟安静地漂在黑暗里。
en: (Temporary opening) The ark drifts quietly through the dark.

zh: 嘿嘿，我就知道！今天学什么？
en: Hehe, I knew it! What are we learning today?

zh: 你又不说话了……那我自己挑课啦。
en: Quiet again... Then I'll pick my classes myself.

zh: （临时）先为她排好第一周的课吧。
en: (Temporary) First, plan her classes for week one.
